title: QCOW2 (QEMU Copy-On-Write v2) signature
summary: QCOW2 is QEMU's native disk image format. The header begins with the 4-byte magic 'QFI\xfb' (0x51 0x46 0x49 0xFB) followed by the version number (2 or 3).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Version: 2 (QCOW2) or 3 (QCOW3, with extended L2 entries and subclusters).

Header: magic (4), version (4), backing_file_offset (8), backing_file_size (4), cluster_bits (4), size (8), crypt_method (4), l1_size (4), l1_table_offset (8), refcount_table_offset (8), refcount_table_clusters (4), nb_snapshots (4), snapshots_offset (8), ... .
QCOW2 supports copy-on-write, snapshots, compression (zlib/zstd), encryption (LUKS/AES), and thin provisioning.
Widely used by QEMU, KVM, libvirt, OpenStack, and cloud platforms.
